title: Orientation
description: auto: a column in tall or square boxes, one band when the page is more than 2.2× wider than tall (top/bottom edges, wide renderer cells).

title: Alignment
description: Which edge the ledger hugs inside its page. right mirrors the column (labels on the outer edge, misses toward the playfield) for the right side of the screen; left for the left side.

title: Backing
description: scrim: a soft dark haze behind the text that fades out on every side (default; keeps it readable over bright skins and backgrounds). none: bare text with a shadow. panel: a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of the panel rule: a tone taken from the map's background, or 18-LAB amber. Judgement colours never change.

title: Compact
description: Drops the column headings, proportion bars and max-achievable readout; keeps counts, misses, combo status, accuracy and combo.

title: Show accuracy
description: Shows accuracy and the maximum accuracy still reachable if every remaining object is caught (needs vosu's or tosu's /api/calculate/pp for the map's object counts; hidden where that is unavailable, e.g. in the replay renderer).
